## Description

A clear and concise description of the bug.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '...'
3. See error

## Expected behaviour

What you expected to happen.

## Actual behaviour

What actually happened. Include the exact status/error message if there is one.

## Environment

- **Coffer version:** (Settings → About, e.g. 1.1.0)
- **Windows version:** (e.g. Windows 11 23H2 x64)
- **Build:** Portable (`Coffer-Portable.exe`) or Installer
- **Using a migrated HeavenlyLock vault?** Yes / No

## Screenshots or logs

If applicable, add screenshots. Relevant lines from `%LocalAppData%\Coffer\crash.log` help a lot.

## Additional context

Anything else that might be relevant.
